requests.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: rear-facing sprite source for an editable skeletal cutout in Escape the Umbra. Input image 1 is the sole character identity/style reference, the accepted front sprite; it is NOT to be redrawn or replaced. Generate ONE matching three-quarter REAR view of precisely this hunched Tunnel Crawler, turned away toward upper-left on a 2:1 isometric ground plane. Preserve the bulky rounded mottled brown back, bald small head tucked forward, pale blind eyes (mostly hidden from behind), emaciated long arms with distinct hooked claw hands, thick crouching hind thighs, skinny digitigrade ankles and claw toes. Exactly four limbs: two long arms and two rear legs; no tail, no extra arms, no gear. Preserve its grubby brown/grey flesh palette, dark outlines and chunky painterly pixel cluster detail rather than smooth rendering. Same full-body proportions and crouching height as the reference. Show anatomically coherent upper arms/elbows/wrists, both hind legs and planted ground contact, with modest space separating the hands and feet for later segmentation. Camera from above, looking at back and left side, no front face aimed at viewer. One whole assembled creature centered with generous transparent padding, full claws visible, truly transparent alpha background, no floor, shadow, labels, grid or checkerboard. Do not restyle, beautify, add clothes, horns, shell, weapon or different anatomy.

requests.disposition: Selected matching back/side view; uniformly register and reflect to upper-right canonical rear.
